semantics.storage: Eight D flip-flops sharing clk and reset
semantics.update: At each positive edge of clk, q becomes 8'b00000000 if reset is high, otherwise q becomes the sampled d
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset, with priority over data capture
semantics.hold: q retains its value between positive clock edges, including on negative edges and reset transitions
semantics.initialization: No power-up value specified; no initialization added
semantics.throughput: One eight-bit capture at every positive edge when reset is low

numeric.representation: Eight independent bits with exact bit-for-bit transfer d[7:0] to q[7:0]
numeric.arithmetic: None; no rounding, saturation, overflow, or signed arithmetic

verification.oracle: Independently track expected q from reset and d sampled at each rising edge; compare after sequential updates settle
verification.data_coverage: Exhaust all 256 eight-bit input patterns with reset low
verification.reset_coverage: Check reset priority for all 256 d patterns, sustained reset, and return to capture after reset deassertion
verification.timing_coverage: Change d and assert/deassert reset between rising edges, verifying hold before the next rising edge and across falling edges
verification.initial_state: Do not require a known value before the first capture/reset edge
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp, finite external timeouts and testbench watchdog
